<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **20** documentable anchor(s).

**18** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9f6f306c431add0f7228c180587450faa0f3a1e8`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **250** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **179** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9f6f306c431add0f7228c180587450faa0f3a1e8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `318ec0b8a9911fcd2849aa47663788a5ee066bd8` — the merge of head `058d5c28159de07a922922e89eee395e9e3dfbd3` into base `9f6f306c431add0f7228c180587450faa0f3a1e8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 318ec0b8a9911fcd2849aa47663788a5ee066bd8 && git checkout 318ec0b8a9911fcd2849aa47663788a5ee066bd8
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9f6f306c431add0f7228c180587450faa0f3a1e8 058d5c28159de07a922922e89eee395e9e3dfbd3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 9f6f306c431add0f7228c180587450faa0f3a1e8 && git merge --no-ff 058d5c28159de07a922922e89eee395e9e3dfbd3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9f6f306c431add0f7228c180587450faa0f3a1e8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9f6f306c431add0f7228c180587450faa0f3a1e8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

L1 ACCEPT · head `f4e83b06c2d6e64daa0cb8e7cfb44ae4340c4f6d` · 2026-11-22T10:50Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用 `composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })` 拼包时,没有包标识的那部分给某个对象加的字段,现在能正常使用了。以前这些字段直接消失,写入时报 `INVALID_FIELD`,启动日志也不提。
- 新拦下两种写法,在拼包时报 `422 STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`:两个没有包标识的部分声明同名定时任务(以前启动时两个都不运行);没有包标识的部分和持有产物标识的那个包,给同一对象各加一段不同的扩展(以前只有后一段生效)。
- 为什么做:卡 #35711,拼包「剩余部分」这一组问题里的最后一个漏洞。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是拼包时多拦了不该拦的写法,作者会看到点名两处的报错;已经构建好的产物照常启动,只多一条错误日志;不涉及数据迁移,可以撤回。
- 要你做什么:无(见下面落地条款给席位的一点)。

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36338` 只标了 dogfood 一项,见下面。draft、base `main`、`Fixes #35711`;卡上「先测量」三步都在正文里,经真实的 `os serve` 量过;产出方只有 `'preserve'`;修复覆盖卡上 Expected 的两条,所以用 `Fixes` 是对的。9 个文件 +862 −43;`check-governed-merges` 判定 NOT governed,905 行。超出原认领面的 `metadata/src/plugin.ts`、`objectql/src/engine-registration.ts` 和迁移条目,席位正在补进认领,我按补后的范围读。
- 声明:`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` 属实。新导出的 `objectExtensionContribution`、`equalByValue` 只从 `engine-registration.ts` 导出,objectql 的包导出只有 `.` 和 `./core`,两者都不转出这个文件;metadata 新增的函数都没有导出;`UnclaimedTopLevelItem.type` 本来就是 `string`。收窄的两种写法都写在 changeset 里了。`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`:ADR-0087 语义条目 `18.stack-residual-extension-registered-and-jobs-judged` 已登记,changeset 三个包都是 `minor`,带 `!` 和 BREAKING。`Skills-docs: none` 的理由成立:没有 skill 教这种写法,报错本身写明了改法。
- 实现读法:
  - metadata 的 `unclaimedTopLevel` 现在把顶层的 `objectExtensions` 条目列为 `object_extension`,前提是它有目标,并且没有任何包体里有一条和它按值相等的条目。按值而不按目标比,是因为展平后的顶层会重复每个包体的条目。metadata 自己仍不登记扩展:`registerArtifactBodyCollections` 用 `artifactItemSlot` 判断,扩展没有槽位,会被跳过,所以剩余计数和告警不变。
  - objectql 在所有包体之后,以剩余部分的 id 经 `extend` 登记这些条目。包体和剩余部分都走 `objectExtensionContribution` 这一种读法,`place` 也包括在内,所以两边不会走样。共享槽位的情况每个对象记一条 `error`;引用了包体都没声明的选项列表的条目不登记,记一条 `warn`。
  - spec 拼包门的剩余判断与此对齐:扩展按值相等认领;持有 `manifest.id` 的那个包体对同一目标的条目排在前面,一起判断。`jobs` 改为按名字判断,只要任一包体用了这个名字,就算被认领。
- 文本逐句核:changeset 的 Fixed、Refused now、Wording、Unchanged、Installed artifacts 五段,以及最后的一行改法,都与 diff 一致;报错例句「body 的条目在前、剩余的在后」与 spec 用例逐字相同。迁移条目的 surface、replacement、reason、acceptanceCriteria 四段与 changeset 一致。
- 测试证据:spec 9 条,含两种拒绝,`code`、`status`、条数、整句都有断言;对照用例包括单个剩余任务、各包体自己的任务、两个包各扩展一个目标、持有者包体自己的一对只报一次。metadata 3 条,分别在拼包后和构建后的 JSON 上测,对照是全部由包体认领。objectql 6 条,经 `manifest` 服务在内核上跑:剩余字段被服务;和同一条目从包体登记时服务的内容一致;带 `place` 的条目也一致,而且 `place` 确实改变了服务的结果;共享槽位只服务后一段,记 1 条 `error`;引用未知选项列表的条目不登记,记 `warn`。消融 A 到 E 各挂对应的用例,恢复后 blob 一致。真实 `os serve` 在修复后列出 `residual_note`,带它写入能创建记录。这些用例我没有在本地重跑,读的是报告和 CI。
- dogfood(由我判断):`!` 和 `(narrowing)` 欠一轮完整测试电池,正文在 f4e83b06c2 上全量跑了一轮:4175 条里 4107 过、68 跳过、0 失败,和 head 一致,所以这项满足。
- CI @ `f4e83b06`:60 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;mergeable_state clean。
- nit:「两条扩展按值相等」现在有三种写法:metadata 的 `sameAuthoredValue`、spec 的 `deepEqualAuthored`、objectql 的 `equalByValue`。前两者的注释说它们读法一致,但我没看到有用例把它们钉成相等。目前 objectql 那一处只用在已经判定为不相等的条目上,所以不影响结果。
- 范围外(两条都是读代码看出来的,没有实测;请席位决定要不要立卡):
  1. 如果一个剩余任务和某个包体的任务同名(哪怕内容不同),它会被当作包体的副本,`residualEntryPredicate` 不判断它。但启动时 `jobNameCollisions`(`runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts:1403`)会把剩余部分算进去,两个都 `NOT SCHEDULED`。这和本 PR 处理的「剩余扩展与持有者包体共享槽位」是同一类问题,只是落在任务上。
  2. 一个剩余选项列表如果只被剩余扩展的字段引用,`unreferencedResidualPicklists` 只看包体和剩余对象,所以照样把它判为「没有字段引用」并在启动时拒绝,那句话就不对了。本 PR 之前也是这样,本 PR 没让它变差。
- 落地条款:收窄、非受管、905 行。席位的 schema 面 L2 PASS、认领补齐之后,由区 ready + auto-merge。给席位的一点:正文「维护者速读」第 4 条写「需要你决定是否合入」,最后一段又写「the maintainer lands it」,这和 `check-governed-merges` 的判定(NOT governed,不到 3000 行)不一致。如果认领里的条件确实要求维护者合,就保留;否则请把第 4 条改成「无」,免得维护者以为要他动手。这不是声明行,我不改判。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f4e83b06c2d6e64daa0cb8e7cfb44ae4340c4f6d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.stack-residual-extension-registered-and-jobs-judged.ts + packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts, packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Inputs read: card #35711 (body and all 6 comments), PR #36338 (body, 9 files, net diff against merge base `d8599c2ca2`), and the check-runs on the head. Every check-run is `success` or `skipped`. None failed. Tests, the changeset and the rest of the diff are the lane seat's ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set changes the diff implies at `composeStacks`, each read from the code:

1. Two top-level `jobs` of one name that no package body declares, in a composition that carries `packages[]`: refused now. Right. On main `residualEntryPredicate` sent `jobs` to the slot rule, which never files a job as residual, so no door judged the pair. The boot's binder (`jobNameCollisions`, `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts`) schedules neither. Declared.
2. A residual `objectExtensions` entry for an object that the body carrying `manifest.id` also extends with other fields: refused now, body entry first. Right. The residual registers under that id and the registry keeps one extension of a target per package. Declared.
3. Two residual `objectExtensions` entries for one object that some package body also extends: refused now. Right as a refusal, because both register under `manifest.id` and only the last is served. NOT declared. On main the claim was by target (`SAME_STACK_ENTRY_IDENTITY.objectExtensions.identity`), so both entries counted as a body's copies and composed. The head claims by value, so both are the residual's. See S1.
4. Reach beyond `'preserve'`: `packages` is a concat key, so `'first'`, `'last'` or an index with an input that is itself a multi-package artifact also carries `packages[]` beside a residual. Shapes 1 to 3 are refused there too. Right, and the jsdoc on `collectComposedResidualDuplicateEntryErrors` says so. The PR body, the changeset and the migration entry say `'preserve'` only. See S1.
5. A single residual extension, including one for an object another package extends: accepted as before, and now registered. Right. This is the card's fix and it is not a narrowing.
6. A residual entry equal by value to a body's entry: read as that body's copy at composition and at boot. Right. Nothing is lost, because the body registers the same content.

Public-surface changes:

- `@objectstack/metadata` `unclaimedTopLevel` now lists `object_extension` items. Right. The three other readers filter by type (`unclaimedTopLevelItems`, the CLI view walk, `unreferencedResidualPicklists`), and the metadata door skips an item with no slot, so it registers none.
- `@objectstack/objectql` exports `objectExtensionContribution` and `equalByValue` from `engine-registration.ts`. Right. `registerApp` step 2b and the residual path now build one contribution, `place` included.
- The `jobs` row text changed at every door. Right for two enabled jobs. See N3.
- Boot: a residual extension now passes the registry's `extend` door, so a refusal that door raises now fails a boot that used to load and drop the entry. Right, it is what a body's entry gets, and the jsdoc says so. The changeset does not. See N4.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is right. The diff refuses compositions that compose on main, and the claim's own conditional names that a narrowing. `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is right: a value an author can write is now refused. `narrowed` takes at least `minor` on each package the diff moves, and the changeset gives `minor` to `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/objectql`. All three move. The level is right.

The changeset carries both declaration lines, the `Skills-docs:` line, the `**BREAKING**` banner, a one-line fix, and exactly one ADR-0087 marker, `registered stack-residual-extension-registered-and-jobs-judged`. The marker id equals the entry id in the semantic migration file. A registered semantic entry with no D2 conversion is the right disposition: which of two jobs or two extensions to keep is the author's choice. `Check Changeset` and `Lint & Repo Gates` are green on the head.

The migration is owed and present. Its text is incomplete. See S1.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question in the first dev report (who unifies the two extension literals after #36236): answered on this head. `objectExtensionContribution` is the one reading and step 2b calls it.
- Second dev report: `open_questions` is empty. `security_findings` is none. I found none either.
- Deviation, declaration lines differ from the dispatch order: right, see ②.
- Deviation, file surface wider than the claim: justified. The claim placed `unclaimedTopLevel` in `stack.zod.ts`. It lives in `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`, and the fix cannot avoid it. `engine-registration.ts` is needed for the one reading. The migration entry is owed by the narrowing. The seat should record that the area lease named two paths and the diff has five source files.
- Deviation, main merged in: needed, #36236 moved step 2b.
- Deviation, suites run outside the verify lock: a process matter. The check-runs on the head are the gate verdicts and they are green.
- SQL push-down: no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join is added. No finding.
- Escalated to the maintainer with the landing decision: shapes 3 and 4 in ① are narrowings the PR body's summary does not name. It says two shapes are newly refused.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`: holds against the card and the boot code. The by-value claim for extensions mirrors `claimedArtifactExtensions` in metadata. `deepEqualAuthored`, `sameAuthoredValue` and `equalByValue` agree on undefined keys, arrays and depth. `ownerBodyExtensionEntries` finds the same body the boot finds (`artifactPackageId(body) === ownerId`), and puts its entries first, which is the boot's registration order. The `jobs` row is one row at every door. `data` is untouched, because the duplicate door never asks about it.

`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`: agrees with its jsdoc. An entry is listed when it names a target and no body carries an equal entry.

`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`: agrees with its jsdoc. Registration is last, under the residual id, through `extend`. The dangling-picklist class follows the residual objects' rule. A residual picklist that only a residual extension names is still refused by `unreferencedResidualPicklists` at validate, build and boot, so that case is refused where it is written.

`packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts`: one reading, both callers. Holds.

S1 (should-fix) — The migration entry under-describes what composition now refuses. Its `surface` names two shapes under `'preserve'` with inputs that carry no manifest. The code also refuses (a) two residual extensions of one object when a package body extends that object too, which composed on main, and (b) all of these shapes in a `'first'`, `'last'` or index composition that carries `packages[]` from a multi-package input, where an input WITH a manifest is also part of the residual. The changeset's "Refused now" list and the PR body's "Newly refused" list have the same gap, and the PR body states that only `'preserve'` yields a residual, which the jsdoc in the same diff contradicts. Fix: name (a) and (b) in `surface`, `replacement` and `reason`, and in the changeset and PR body.

S2 (should-fix) — A residual job that shares its name with a package body's job, with different content, still composes, and the boot schedules neither. `residualEntryPredicate` claims a job by name, so the residual job is read as the body's copy. The binder counts by name: the top level holds two enabled jobs of the name, so `jobNameCollisions` refuses both. This is read from code, not driven. The card asks that a residual job is not accepted and then left unrun, and the new `jobs` sentence states the very rule that unschedules this pair. The jsdoc does not say the name claim also covers a different job. Two bodies each declaring the name have the same boot outcome, and the new CONTROL test pins that they compose. Close it one of two ways: judge the pair at composition (a further narrowing, to be declared), or state in the jsdoc and the migration entry that a cross-package job name is left to the binder and file a follow-up card for the maintainer to rule.

Nits, no effect on this head:

- N1: `packages/metadata/src/picklist-references.ts` (outside the diff) still tells authors that a top-level `objectExtensions` entry of a composed stack is not registered. After this PR that is true only for an entry whose field names a picklist no body declares. Follow-up prose fix.
- N2: `logResidualSameTargetExtensions` adds every owner-body entry, not only those for a target the residual extends. When the owner body has its own pair for one object and the residual extends another, the boot prints a second error line for the pair `registerApp` already reported. The spec side filters to the residual's targets. Follow-up.
- N3: the `jobs` sentence ends "so none of them runs". When one of the two is disabled, the binder counts no collision. The sentence is exact only for two enabled jobs. Accepted deviation.
- N4: the changeset's "Installed artifacts keep loading" bullet covers only the shared-slot shape. A built artifact whose residual extension the `extend` door refuses now fails its boot. Reachable only through `strict: false` or a hand-built artifact. Follow-up wording.
- N5: `sameAuthoredValue` in metadata is a hand copy of the spec's `deepEqualAuthored`, and no test holds the two equal. Follow-up.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-35711-residual-extension-jobs`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC`

**VERDICT: PASS**

L1 ACCEPT(增量)· head `058d5c28159de07a922922e89eee395e9e3dfbd3` · 2026-11-22T13:15Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:和上一轮一样。用 `composeStacks` 拼包时,没有包标识的那部分给对象加的字段,现在能正常使用;拼包时会新拦下几种写法,只有后一段生效、或者两个都不运行的写法。这一轮只补了说明和两条测试,代码没变。
- 为什么做:卡 #35711。这一轮是对席位契约档 L2 的 S1 和 S2 两条的修改。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是拼包时多拦了不该拦的写法,作者会看到点名两处的报错。已经构建好的产物照常启动。可以撤回。
- 要你做什么:这个 PR 是声明过的收窄。按队列守卫,它要等你批准后才能合入,席位会交给你。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。

## 增量核对(`f4e83b06` → `058d5c28`,2 个提交,4 个文件)

- **L2 S1(迁移说明没写全被拦下的写法)已改。** 我逐句核了迁移条目 18 的 `surface`、`replacement`、`reason`,changeset 的 Refused now 段,以及 PR 正文第 34 行。三处现在都写了三种被拦下的写法:
  1. 两个同名的剩余 job;
  2. 剩余的对象扩展和持有 `manifest.id` 的那个包扩展同一个对象;
